✨ The Story of This The Place!

A Culinary Journey of Pan-Asian & Oriental Delights

Located Near Orocare Dental Clinic in Madhapur, This The Place! offers an unforgettable casual dining experience celebrating authentic Chinese, Oriental, fresh seafood, and popular Asian street appetizers. From our signature Dragon Chicken and Butter Garlic Prawns to hearty bowls of Hakka Noodles and steaming Dimsums, each dish is made fresh to order.

🔥

Wok-Mastered Asian Flavours

High-flame wok cooking locking in intense smoky aromatics, crisp veggies, and succulent proteins.

🥟

Handmade Dimsums & Momos

Artisanal steamed and fried dumplings prepared fresh daily with authentic Sichuan chilli dips.

🍤

Fresh Seafood Selections

Fresh tiger prawns and tender fish fillets tossed in aromatic butter garlic and Kung Pao sauces.

🏆

Exceptional Taste & Value

Lavish Chinese and Pan-Asian feast portions starting at just ₹950 for two people in Madhapur.

✓ Fresh Seafood Daily ✓ Cozy Dining Ambience ✓ Open 7 Days a Week
